findings.reason: The cited evidence shows high PRB and user spikes but does not explicitly confirm the 'sharp surge' as the sole driver or rule out other causes like backhaul degradation.
T1, T7, and ALR-0028 all confirm latency and active user anomalies on both sites starting at 18:30 on 2026-09-18.
ANM-000204 explicitly states the active users spike on S-SFX-002 from baseline 319 to 695.
ANM-000205 explicitly states the dl_volume_mb spike on S-SFX-002 from baseline 23438 to 67001.
T9 output confirms no maintenance windows were scheduled on the specified nodes and parents during the time window.
T4 output confirms no external events were recorded for region SFX during the specified time window.
